eligible_games.rule: distinct canonical_game_id of the eligible player-games

eligible_player_games.rule: ELIG_MINUTES rows whose counting labels are available (box row present and no source accounting issue); rows with unavailable count labels stay in ELIG_MINUTES with NaN counts and are excluded from every count fit and score (never imputed to 0)

eligible_player_seasons_for_rate_prior.rule: player-season box finals (feat.player_box_state, last available row) with minutes >= 100; method-of-moments prior strength k uses seasons <= train_through

identity_requirements: target player-game has a canonical player id (RESOLVED); cross-season history never crosses a quarantined identity link; identity-conflict player-seasons masked

count labels with a source accounting is.assumption: MCAR with respect to the count given the box row (source defect)
count labels with a source accounting is.handling: row excluded from count fits (NaN), kept for minutes

pit_fidelity_requirement.checkpoint: single pregame cutoff = scheduled tip - 1 h (spec.CUTOFF_RULE), i.e. the T-1h checkpoint

inputs.earlier-game box rows, participation and: DATE_KNOWN (HR-1: tip + 4 h, or 06:00 ET next day)

pit_fidelity_requirement.note: no SOURCE_RECEIPT_UNKNOWN or UNUSABLE_FOR_HISTORICAL_PIT input enters these subsystems (end-of-season roster snapshots are used only for the NOT_ON_ROSTER LABEL, which is excluded). The PRESEASON_ASSUMED class is carried by the Stage 3 1900-01-01 preseason sentinel, not by an explicit fidelity column: the bitemporal rebuild (Phase A2 item 1) is outstanding (ARCHITECTURE_PRECEDENCE.md §4.4)

quarantine_rules.event_team_attribution: not applicable (no event rows are read)
quarantine_rules.identity: target rows exist only for resolved canonical players in the pregame universe; unresolved box rows are counted in lab.target_box_rows_unresolved (EXCLUDED_BOX_ROW_IDENTITY_UNRESOLVED); identity_conflicts rows are masked in the src views (stage3/sources.py); history never crosses metadata.identity_link_quarantine (spec.link_guard)
quarantine_rules.pbp_score_mismatch: 4,138 PBP FINAL_SCORE_MISMATCH games are excluded from flagship.plays; these subsystems read box rows and the substitution feed, not plays, so the rule does not select their rows. The eligible rows inside those games are COUNTED below (pbp_quarantine_overlap)
quarantine_rules.reconstruction_class: not applicable (no possessions or stints are read)
quarantine_rules.team_attribution: v2.4 DEMIRROR_RECONCILED_GAMES copies are in qa.identity_remediation_quarantine and never reach fact.player_games / the trusted views

required_sources.feat.player_features: Stage 3 approved pregame features (prediction cutoff = tip - 1 h)
required_sources.lab.player_game_labels: Stage 3 label store (participation_status, box_row_present, minutes_label_available, counting_labels_available)
required_sources.upstream: flagship.played_games / fact.player_games (trusted), flagship.substitutions, core.rosters, core.recruits, core.transfers

rule: ELIG_MINUTES rows whose counting labels are available (box row present and no source accounting issue); rows with unavailable count labels stay in ELIG_MINUTES with NaN counts and are excluded from every count fit and score (never imputed to 0)
rule_sql: SELECT l.player_game_example_id AS id, l.canonical_game_id AS game, l.season FROM lb.lab.player_game_labels l JOIN feat.player_features f USING (player_game_example_id) WHERE l.season BETWEEN 2014 AND 2025 AND l.participation_status = 'PLAYED' AND l.box_row_present AND l.minutes_label_available AND l.counting_labels_available
selection_bias_reference: docs/PBP_QUARANTINE_SELECTION_BIAS_PLAN.md (box-row absence is informative; the participation exclusion of UNKNOWN labels is non-random)
